summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead over Max Verstappen, needing to manage pressure as Mercedes pursues a constructors' title defense against Ferrari's late charge. George Russell's practice pace sets up an intriguing Mercedes internal battle for pole position and track supremacy under the city lights. With two races remaining after Las Vegas, Antonelli can move within striking distance of the drivers' championship while Mercedes battles to extend its constructors' advantage.
